title: House of Earth and Blood
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: In a modern city shared by angels, fae and shifters, a young woman still reeling from her friends' murder is pushed into working with a brutal assassin. They must track the killer, who has started again.
readIf: you want urban fantasy with a murder investigation, a grief-stricken heroine and a lot of banter and heat.
skipIf: you prefer traditional medieval fantasy, or find a modern slang-heavy style distracting.

pairings.reason: Same author, with a similar damaged heroine and a long road from guilt toward healing.
Another dark urban fantasy where a haunted young woman becomes tangled in a murder mystery.
Another long romantasy with a slow-burn bond between a guarded heroine and a dangerous man.
